COMMERCIAL LEASE DEED
Lessor: Saffron Estates Pvt. Ltd.
Lessee: Tidewater Logistics Pvt. Ltd.
Premises: Unit 4B, Harbor Street Warehouse Complex, Chennai.
The premises have a total area of 18,500 square feet.
The lease commences on 1 July 2025.

1. Rent and Deposit
Monthly rent is INR 4,85,000, payable by the 5th day of each month.
Rent escalates by 5% every twelve months from the commencement date.
The Lessee pays a security deposit of six months rent, INR 29,10,000, refundable at exit.

2. Lock-in and Termination
The lease has a lock-in period of twenty-four (24) months.
After the lock-in, either party may terminate with three (3) months written notice.
3. Charges and Disputes
The Lessee bears electricity and water charges for the premises.
Disputes are resolved by arbitration in Chennai under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act.
contracts/msa-northwind-bluepeak-scan.pd:
MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT
This Master Services Agreement is made between Northwind Analytics Pvt. Ltd. (the Client)
and Bluepeak Systems LLP (the Service Provider).
The Effective Date of this Agreement is 1 April 2025.
1. Scope of Services
The Service Provider will design, build and operate a data warehouse for the Client.
Each engagement is described in a Statement of Work signed by both parties.
2. Term
This Agreement has an initial term of thirty-six (36) months from the Effective Date.
It renews automatically for successive twelve (12) month periods unless terminated.

3. Fees and Payment
The Client shall pay each undisputed invoice within forty-five (45) days of receipt.
Late payments accrue interest at 1.5% per month on the overdue amount.
The monthly operations retainer is INR 2,75,000 plus applicable GST.
4. Limitation of Liability
Total liability of each party is capped at the fees paid in the 12 months before the claim.
Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential losses.

5. Termination
Either party may terminate for convenience with ninety (90) days written notice.
Either party may terminate at once for a material breach not cured within thirty (30) days.
6. Governing Law and Jurisdiction
This Agreement is governed by the laws of India.
The courts at Bengaluru, Karnataka have exclusive jurisdiction.
Signed for the Client by Meera Raghavan, Chief Operating Officer.
Signed for the Service Provider by Daniel Okafor, Managing Partner.
